queries.title: Stops of people perceived as unhoused, and what they resulted in
queries.method: Persons in Stop fixture, stops by the officer's perceived-unhoused entry, joined on stop and person number to Stop fixture, results and Stop fixture, property. Arrested means a result naming a custodial arrest; arrests on an outstanding warrant and arrests without a warrant are also counted apart, since a warrant arrest follows from the warrant rather than the stop. Cited means a citation or an in-field cite and release. Arrest and citation rates are over persons with a row in Stop fixture, results, since a person with no row has no recorded outcome; property seizure is over all persons. A person can have several results. Perceived unhoused is the officer's entry for each person stopped; rows where it is neither true nor false are counted apart. Rates are not adjusted for the reason for the stop.
queries.sql:
WITH stop_persons AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("pid" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS person, CASE LOWER(TRIM(CAST("perceivedunhoused" AS VARCHAR))) WHEN 'true' THEN 'unhoused' WHEN 'false' THEN 'not unhoused' END AS perceived, TRY_CAST(CAST("stopdate" AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) AS stopped_on
 FROM "analysis_stop_stops"
), stop_results AS (
 SELECT CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("pid" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS person, BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'custodial arrest')) AS arrested, BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'arrest without warrant')) AS warrantless, BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'outstanding warrant')) AS on_warrant,
  BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'citation') OR CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'cite and release')) AS cited
 FROM "analysis_stop_results" GROUP BY 1
), stop_seized AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("pid" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS person FROM "analysis_stop_property")
SELECT perceived, COUNT(*) AS persons, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE arrested) AS arrested, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE on_warrant) AS arrested_on_warrant, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE warrantless) AS arrested_without_warrant, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cited) AS cited,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stop_results.person IS NOT NULL) AS persons_with_result, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stop_results.person IS NULL) AS no_result_row, 'Stop fixture, results' AS results_table,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stop_seized.person IS NOT NULL) AS property_seized,
 CAST(MIN(stopped_on) FILTER (WHERE stopped_on >= DATE '2000-01-01') AS VARCHAR) AS first_stop, CAST(MAX(stopped_on) AS VARCHAR) AS last_stop
FROM stop_persons LEFT JOIN stop_results ON stop_results.person = stop_persons.person LEFT JOIN stop_seized ON stop_seized.person = stop_persons.person
GROUP BY perceived ORDER BY perceived

queries.title: Why people perceived as unhoused were stopped, and arrests for the same reason
queries.method: The recorded reason code text from Stop fixture, reasons for each person stopped, with how many persons perceived as unhoused and how many others were stopped for it and how many of each were arrested without a warrant (a result naming a custodial arrest without warrant), so an outstanding warrant does not explain the arrest. Arrest rates are over persons with a row in Stop fixture, results. The forty reasons with the most persons perceived as unhoused are read. A person with two reasons is counted under each. Perceived unhoused is the officer's entry for each person stopped; rows where it is neither true nor false are counted apart.
queries.sql:
WITH stop_persons AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("pid" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS person, CASE LOWER(TRIM(CAST("perceivedunhoused" AS VARCHAR))) WHEN 'true' THEN 'unhoused' WHEN 'false' THEN 'not unhoused' END AS perceived, TRY_CAST(CAST("stopdate" AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) AS stopped_on
 FROM "analysis_stop_stops"
), stop_results AS (
 SELECT CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("pid" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS person, BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'custodial arrest')) AS arrested, BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'arrest without warrant')) AS warrantless, BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'outstanding warrant')) AS on_warrant,
  BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'citation') OR CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'cite and release')) AS cited
 FROM "analysis_stop_results" GROUP BY 1
), stop_reasons AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("pid" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS person, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("reasonforstopcodetext" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS reason FROM "analysis_stop_reasons"
)
SELECT reason, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE perceived = 'unhoused') AS unhoused_persons, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE perceived = 'unhoused' AND stop_results.person IS NOT NULL) AS unhoused_with_result, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE perceived = 'unhoused' AND warrantless) AS unhoused_arrested,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE perceived = 'not unhoused') AS other_persons, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE perceived = 'not unhoused' AND stop_results.person IS NOT NULL) AS other_with_result, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE perceived = 'not unhoused' AND warrantless) AS other_arrested
FROM stop_persons JOIN stop_reasons ON stop_reasons.person = stop_persons.person LEFT JOIN stop_results ON stop_results.person = stop_persons.person
WHERE reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reason ORDER BY unhoused_persons DESC, reason LIMIT 40

queries.title: Why property was seized from people perceived as unhoused
queries.method: Persons perceived as unhoused with a row in Stop fixture, property, by the recorded basis for the seizure. A person with two bases is counted under each. The table records that property was seized, not where it was kept or whether it was returned.
queries.sql:
WITH stop_persons AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("pid" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS person, CASE LOWER(TRIM(CAST("perceivedunhoused" AS VARCHAR))) WHEN 'true' THEN 'unhoused' WHEN 'false' THEN 'not unhoused' END AS perceived, TRY_CAST(CAST("stopdate" AS VARCHAR) AS DATE) AS stopped_on
 FROM "analysis_stop_stops"
), stop_results AS (
 SELECT CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("pid" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS person, BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'custodial arrest')) AS arrested, BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'arrest without warrant')) AS warrantless, BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'outstanding warrant')) AS on_warrant,
  BOOL_OR(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'citation') OR CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("result" AS VARCHAR))), 'cite and release')) AS cited
 FROM "analysis_stop_results" GROUP BY 1
), stop_basis AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("pid" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS person, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("basisforpropertyseizure" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS basis FROM "analysis_stop_property"
)
SELECT basis, COUNT(*) AS persons FROM stop_persons JOIN stop_basis ON stop_basis.person = stop_persons.person
WHERE perceived = 'unhoused' AND basis IS NOT NULL GROUP BY basis ORDER BY persons DESC, basis
